items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: Johnny used to play a banjo. He died. Johnny? What was his last name? Johnny, uh—Johnny Simon.

ctx.x: I used to call him the same house. He was down there. Yeah? Yeah, he was here. He was still in the same house. He's been here all that time. He's been here a long time. Yeah. I got a son. He's a postman over there, you see. I used to teach him how to play saxophone over here. Tenor. And he was doing good. He was doing real good. He went to California and I'll give him John a sincere address. And he gave Johnny and Johnny, rent him a room. Oh, really? Yeah. Yeah.
Yeah. Johnny rent them a room. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
Is he still playing, Tance? Huh? Is he still playing?
